summary: Implemented the csstranslator.py stubs: a from_xpath classmethod on XPathExpr, pseudo-element dispatch in TranslatorMixin, the ::attr() and ::text handlers, and css2xpath with lru_cache. Last full-suite run: 38 passed, 168 failed, 2 skipped; the 12 translator-class tests pass when run in isolation, most suite failures come from other builders unfinished stubs, and css2xpath(".some-class") differs from the test expectation because installed cssselect 1.6.0 adds a contains(@class) prefilter.
